Usage: clyops-mcp [OPTIONS]

Serve a directory of clyops tools to an AI agent over MCP (stdio): one MCP tool per clyops tool,
with its input schema from the tool's --help-json-schema.

Tools:
  -r, --root=<value>               Tools directory or dispatcher definition file (required, accepts:
                                   path)
  -n, --name=<value>               Server name (default: the directory name)
      --cwd=<value>                Working directory for the tools (default: the current one)
                                   (accepts: existing directory)
  -t, --timeout=<value>            Kill a tool after this many seconds (0: never) (default: 0,
                                   accepts: integer: >=0)
  -w, --watch=<value>              Pick up added, changed and removed tools without a restart
                                   (default: true, accepts: true/false, yes/no, 1/0, on/off)
      --probe-concurrency=<value>  Tools asked for --help-json-schema at the same time when loading
                                   (default: 8, accepts: integer: >=1)
      --probe-timeout=<value>      Seconds each tool has to answer --help-json-schema (default: 30,
                                   accepts: integer: >=1)
      --positionals-order=<value>  Positionals before or after options (default: first, accepts:
                                   choices: first, last)

Schemas:
      --fetch-schemas=<value>      Fetch the URL schemas json:SCHEMA inputs reference, so they are
                                   checked (default: true, accepts: true/false, yes/no, 1/0, on/off)
      --schema-depth=<value>       Levels of references followed from an input's schema (0: fetch
                                   none) (default: 3, accepts: integer: >=0)
      --schema-hosts=<value>       Fetch schemas only from this host (example.com, or *.example.com
                                   for its subdomains); default: any (multiple)
      --schema-cache=<value>       Seconds a fetched schema is reused before it is fetched again (0:
                                   every load) (default: 3600, accepts: integer: >=0)
      --schema-timeout=<value>     Seconds each schema fetch may take (default: 5, accepts: integer:
                                   >=1)
      --schema-max-bytes=<value>   Largest schema document fetched, in bytes (default: 1048576,
                                   accepts: integer: >=1)

Security:
  -a, --allow=<value>              Serve only tools matching this glob over their words (media/*,
                                   media/**) (multiple)
  -D, --deny=<value>               Leave out tools matching this glob (multiple)
      --read-only                  Serve only tools that declare the read-only effect
      --paths-within=<value>       Path arguments must resolve inside this directory (multiple,
                                   accepts: existing directory)
      --close-inputs               Don't take file:executable inputs from the agent, nor path inputs
                                   unless --paths-within confines them (as clyops-api does)
      --allow-executable-inputs    With --close-inputs, let the agent set file:executable inputs,
                                   choosing what runs
      --max-output=<value>         Keep at most this many bytes of a tool's stdout and stderr (0:
                                   all) (default: 16777216, accepts: integer: >=0)
      --audit=<value>              Append a JSON line per run to this file (-: stderr) (accepts:
                                   path)

Global:
  -h, --help                       Show this help message and exit

Every option can also be set in the environment as CLYOPS_MCP_<OPTION>.

Examples:
  claude mcp add mytool -- clyops-mcp --root ~/mytool/scripts
  { "mcpServers": { "mytool": { "command": "clyops-mcp", "args": ["--root", "/home/me/mytool/scripts"] } } }
